description: Mystical/spiritual Minecraft mod — Soul Crystal, Tarot Card, Soul Lantern. Fabric 26.2.

mods.name: PsycheIQ Mod
mods.description: Mystical/spiritual mod inspired by PsycheIQ — discover yourself through Mind, Body, and Soul.

releases.notes:
Initial release!

Items:
- Soul Crystal — right-click to absorb spiritual energy (100 XP, portal particles)
- Tarot Card — right-click to draw a random tarot buff (10 effects with End Rod particles)

Block:
- Soul Lantern — purple glowing light source (light level 15)

Crafting:
- Soul Crystal = Amethyst Shard + Echo Shard + Gold Nugget (shapeless)
- Tarot Card = Paper + Gold Nugget + Amethyst Shard = 3 cards (shapeless)
- Soul Lantern = 4 Iron Ingots + Soul Crystal (shaped)

Config: config/psycheiq.properties (XP amount, tarot duration, consumption)

Requires: Minecraft 26.2, Fabric Loader 0.19.3+, Fabric API, Java 25+
